opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be around 10-20% of costs (capital grants for local community projects no greater than £30,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return); work must be within the UK or UK Overseas Territories. Not individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Core grant programme for under £100,000 supporting a wide range of UK charities. Grants can be made for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Applications accepted all year round with no deadlines; decisions aim within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: £100,000 and over. For core costs the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million; for capital or project costs the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts; work within the UK or UKOTs. For a Major Grant the organisation must either have an annual income over £1 million (core costs) or total project/capital costs over £1 million. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) are advised to apply via the Regular Grant route.
opportunities.summary: Grant programme for requests of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines) via the online portal; if taken forward they are invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities.
